## Install (about 1 minute)

1. Download **iCloud-Sync-Assistant-….zip** below and double-click it to unzip.
2. Drag **iCloud Sync Assistant** into your **Applications** folder.
3. Double-click it. The first time, macOS will say it can't check the app for malware, because it isn't from the App Store.
   - Open **System Settings > Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to iCloud Sync Assistant. Then confirm.
   - On macOS 14 or earlier you can instead **right-click** the app, choose **Open**, then click **Open**.
4. Click **Sync Now**. If macOS asks to let the app see iCloud Drive, click **Allow** so it can count files that are still waiting to sync.

Works on macOS 13 Ventura and newer, on both Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
